issue: New entry is not persisted across page reload
actual: Added entry "Zebra QA test entry" (Priority 7, Mar 9 2026, Completed) appeared immediately and count went 5 -> 6 entries. After reloading http://localhost:6074/, the table shows only the original 5 seed entries and "5 entries"; localStorage and sessionStorage are both empty, so no persistence layer exists.

evidence: Fields dialog offers Text/Number/Date/Checkbox options; added field "Score" (Number). It appears as a table column, as a card row, and as a number input in the Add Entry form.
Saved entry "Alpha review draft" with text, Priority 9, date 2026-02-28, Completed checked, Score 42. Card view shows "Alpha review draft | 9 | Feb 28, 2026 | Yes | 42"; table view shows same values.
Table -> Cards -> Table toggling kept 6 entries with identical field values in both views ("6 entries" footer both times).
Priority/Score render as input[type=number]; typing "abc" keystroke-by-keystroke left value "0" (validity.valid=true, badInput=false), while 9 and 42 were accepted and saved.

Due Date is input[type=date]. Setting "2026-02-31" was rejected (value cleared to ""); typing 02/31/2026 left value "" with validity.badInput=true. Valid date 2026-02-28 saved and displays as "Feb 28, 2026".
All 6 entries with identical values in both views; empty Score renders as "—" in table cells and card rows alike.

Field config dropdown lists labeled options Text/Number/Date/Checkbox. Entry form renders input[type=text] for Task Name, input[type=number] for Priority/Score, input[type=date] for Due Date, and a toggle with role=checkbox for Completed.
Form toggle shows aria-checked plus "No"/"Yes" text label; table shows green lucide-check vs muted lucide-x; cards show "Yes"/"No" text with matching icon.

Table sorted Task Name asc (arrow-up) then desc (arrow-down) via header click; Cards independently sorted by Priority asc. Returning to Table still showed Task Name desc while Cards kept Priority asc — independent per-view sort state.
Before/after asc and desc sorts the footer stayed "6 entries" and every row kept its values (e.g. "Alpha review draft | 9 | Feb 28, 2026 | CHECK | 42" unchanged in all orders).

Choosing "Task Name" from the Sort menu instantly reordered rows alphabetically; toolbar button label changed to "Task Name" with an arrow-down/up icon and the active column header shows the direction arrow. App remained interactive afterwards (view switch, dialogs still worked).

actual: No filter control exists anywhere: toolbar has only Fields, Search entries..., Sort, Table/Cards, Add Entry; the Sort menu lists only field names; column headers only toggle sort; the Fields dialog only configures fields. A DOM-wide scan for the string "filter" in document.body.innerHTML returned false. Field-specific filter criteria cannot be defined or cleared.

issue: No filter criteria available, so filter inclusion/clearing cannot be satisfied
actual: The app exposes no filtering UI (no filter button, no per-field filter inputs, no "filter" text in the DOM), so there is no set of active criteria to include entries by and nothing to clear. Only a free-text quick search exists.

evidence: Query "REVIEW" (uppercase) matched "Review marketing materials" and "Alpha review draft"; footer showed "2 entries matching \"REVIEW\"". Clearing the box restored all 6 rows and footer "6 entries".

issue: Quick search matches raw stored values, not the displayed formatted values
actual: Entry "Alpha review draft" displays Due Date "Feb 28, 2026" and Completed "Yes". Searching "Feb 28" returns "0 entries matching \"Feb 28\"", while searching the raw value "2026-02-28" returns that entry. Searching "Yes" (checkbox state shown in cards/forms) returns "0 entries matching \"Yes\"", and "No" likewise does not match unchecked entries.

evidence: After "Clear sort" the footer shows "Drag entries to reorder". Table: moved "Design new landing page" from position 1 to 3 (Review, Update, Design, Prepare, Team, Alpha). Cards: independently moved it to position 2 (Review, Design, Update, ...). Switching back to Table restored the table's own manual order unchanged.

actual: No import entry point anywhere: main toolbar buttons are only Fields/Sort/Table/Cards/Add Entry (+ column sort buttons); no input[type=file], no textarea/paste area, and the string "import" appears 0 times in the rendered DOM. The Fields dialog only lists field rows, an Add-field row, and the advisory note "Configure fields before importing data." — but provides no import control. Type-mismatch rejection on import therefore cannot be exercised.
